title: Predicting Sorghum Yield in Data-Scarce and Conflict-Affected South Sudan Using Machine Learning Techniques.
summary: Machine-learning models forecast sorghum yields in South Sudan under data-scarce and conflict-affected conditions, a specific agricultural planning result. Climate/agricultural observations from two states are used to train and compare decision trees, ANN, random forest, SVM and XGBoost, then predict 2021 yields. Testing: Forecasts are model-derived and remain geographically/time limited; no controlled field intervention is tested..
